<h2>Prepare Spatial Association Map Data</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Completes paleo spatial synthesis results against the intended spatial grid
and preparation inventory so unavailable models are not displayed as zero.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_spatial_association_map_data(
  data_unit,
  data_spatial_grid,
  data_preparation_inventory,
  resolution_ids = base::c("genus", "family", "functional_type")
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_unit">data_unit</code></td>
<td>
<p>Paleo spatial synthesis unit table.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_spatial_grid">data_spatial_grid</code></td>
<td>
<p>Spatial-grid table containing unit bounds.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_preparation_inventory">data_preparation_inventory</code></td>
<td>
<p>Stage 02 preparation inventory.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="resolution_ids">resolution_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character vector of resolution identifiers to include.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble with one row per unit and resolution, an association
percentage, model counts, and an explicit 'availability_status'.
</p>

</main>
